stories.title: Houthi advance down Yemen's Red Sea coast raises energy fears
stories.summary: A rapid Houthi military advance along Yemen's Red Sea coast is spotlighting the Iran-backed group as concerns grow about the global energy market. The move comes amid the ongoing wider Iran conflict.

stories.title: New York sues Polymarket as unlicensed gambling operation
stories.summary: New York state sued prediction market Polymarket, calling it an illegal gambling business that it says puts New Yorkers, especially minors, at risk. Gov. Hochul said the platform knowingly violated state law.

stories.title: Trump hosts Xi at White House for high-stakes summit
stories.summary: Donald Trump welcomed China's Xi Jinping to the White House for a state summit spanning trade, AI, Taiwan and the Iran war. Analysts expect symbolism over substance, but it's the second leaders' meeting in 2026 amid a fragile US-China truce.

stories.title: Google tests letting Gemini make phone calls for you
stories.summary: Google is testing a feature that lets Gemini call businesses on the user's behalf, initially for US Pixel owners. The move pushes AI assistants beyond chat into real-world transactions.

stories.title: Australia probes whether OpenAI hack of health site broke the law
stories.summary: Australia's PM said OpenAI had been hacked and announced an investigation into whether the breach of a government health website broke the law. The incident highlights security gaps around government data.

stories.title: AI builder Lovable tops $600M annualized revenue on vibe coding
stories.summary: Lovable's annualized revenue has crossed $600 million as demand soars for AI-driven 'vibe coding' tools. The milestone underscores how fast app-generation startups are scaling.

stories.title: Ando takes on Slack with human-and-agent workplace messaging
stories.summary: Startup Ando is building a team messaging platform designed for humans and AI agents to collaborate, positioning itself against Slack. It reflects growing demand for agent-ready workplace tools.

stories.title: Browns rise two spots to No. 29 in PFF power rankings
stories.summary: PFF moved Cleveland from No. 31 to No. 29 with a 17% playoff probability after the Browns' rainy 23-19 win at Tampa Bay. Analysts remain cautious but note Deshaun Watson's strong Week 2 passing grade.

stories.title: Watson braces for fans' reaction in first home opener in two years
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson says he isn't sure what reception he'll get Sunday as he makes his first regular-season home start with Cleveland in nearly two years, against Carolina. He emphasized moving past earlier friction with fans.

stories.title: Browns make roster moves, eye Judkins breakout vs Panthers
stories.summary: Cleveland added former Carolina players, made two practice-squad moves and dealt with injuries as it prepared for the Panthers. There's growing buzz that running back Quinshon Judkins could have a breakout game.

stories.title: Buckeyes list 3 out, 5 questionable in first Big Ten availability report
stories.summary: Ohio State's first Big Ten availability report ahead of Illinois shows three players out and five questionable, including tackle Phillip Daniels and edge Zion Grady. It's the first game under the Big Ten's new early-reporting rule.

stories.title: Ryan Day previews Big Ten opener vs Illinois on weekly radio show
stories.summary: Ryan Day faces reporters and his 97.1 The Fan radio show as Ohio State opens Big Ten play Saturday against Illinois at Ohio Stadium. The Buckeyes are multi-touchdown favorites to start conference play 1-0.

stories.title: Ohio State drops to No. 7 in AP and Coaches polls
stories.summary: The Buckeyes slipped one spot to No. 7 in both the AP Top 25 and Coaches Poll after Ole Miss' win over LSU leapfrogged them, despite OSU's 59-3 rout of Kent State.

stories.title: Lawson returns as Lindblad hits trouble in Baku practice
stories.summary: Liam Lawson was back in the Racing Bulls in Baku while teammate Arvid Lindblad crashed during practice. It was a contrasting session for the team ahead of the Azerbaijan GP.

stories.title: Audi says upgrade package 'delivering as expected' in Baku
stories.summary: Mattia Binotto said Audi's new upgrade package is 'delivering as expected' after first practice in Azerbaijan. The team is chasing gains as it builds toward a fully works operation.

stories.title: Cadillac recruit technical leaders from Red Bull and Ferrari
stories.summary: Cadillac has hired technical leaders from Red Bull and Ferrari as part of its long-term development push. The hires reinforce the new team's ambition to be competitive quickly.

stories.title: Russell leads Antonelli and Verstappen in Baku FP2
stories.summary: George Russell topped second practice in Baku ahead of team-mate Andrea Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen. Mercedes locked out the top two spots on day one of the Azerbaijan GP.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov: Arena kicks off free weekend Sept 24-27
stories.summary: Escape from Tarkov: Arena is free to play from Sept 24-27, with discounts on full and standard editions, Twitch Drops and new BattlePass Season 3 'Morbus Imperium' content including the 'The Lab' map and reworked BlastGang mode.

stories.title: Arrest made in deadly west Columbus shooting
stories.summary: Columbus police charged 27-year-old Zackary Burroughs with murder in a deadly shooting on Wheatland Avenue in west Columbus. Detectives identified the victim and made an arrest in the case.

stories.title: 10TV anchor Tracy Townsend stepping away from news
stories.summary: Tracy Townsend, longtime WBNS-10TV morning anchor and Emmy/Murrow winner, announced she is leaving television news, with her last day set for Sept. 30. She called her 10TV tenure an 'incredible chapter.'

stories.title: Ohio AG recommends criminalizing Flock camera misuse
stories.summary: Ohio's attorney general recommended making misuse of Flock automated license-plate camera technology a crime. The guidance addresses growing privacy concerns around police use of the surveillance system.
